title: Explicit platform and preview Use choices continue once while preserving comparison, support ordering and Review
steps: Run tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1811-onboarding-fewer-clicks.mjs; it starts the real wizard/CSS browser fixture with API mocks and closes its browser/server.
expect: Platform Enter continues once; arrows do not navigate; Back preserves the choice.
Preview Use continues to system/address according to the selected template; ordinary gallery selection stays available for comparison.
A delayed support response for a newly used template cannot reuse the previous template's response.
Editing a template from Review returns to Review, with no create request before confirmation.
